meta.name: hunt-dispatch
meta.description: Skill-set loader for /hunt orchestrator. Fingerprints the target, picks the right platform attack skills, and loads the Red Team or WAPT skill set. Use when /hunt has just received a mode answer (redteam or wapt + blackbox|greybox) and needs to load the appropriate skills and print the taxonomy. Not for direct user invocation.

copy.tagline: 根据目标指纹加载红队或渗透测试技能集
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要根据目标自动选择并加载攻击技能集
copy.tagline_en: Load red team or penetration testing skill sets based on target fingerprint
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically select and load attack skill sets based on target fingerprint

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先扫描目标主机，根据返回的指纹信号（如登录页面、云平台、框架等）自动加载对应的攻击技能包，然后打印一份技能清单，最后把控制权交回给 /hunt 命令。
howto.when: 当你在 /hunt 命令中选择了模式（redteam 或 wapt）并指定了黑盒/灰盒后，这个技能会自动触发，负责加载所需的技能集。

say.note: Claude 会加载红队技能包并扫描目标指纹。

say.text: 启动 /hunt，模式设为 wapt，灰盒。
say.note: Claude 会加载 WAPT 技能包，并验证提供的凭证。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scans target hosts, fingerprints them (e.g., login pages, cloud platforms, frameworks), loads the matching attack skill set, prints a taxonomy, and returns control to /hunt.
howto.when_en: Triggered automatically when /hunt receives a mode answer (redteam or wapt + blackbox|greybox) and needs to load the appropriate skills and print the taxonomy.

say_en.note: Claude loads red team skills and fingerprints targets.
Claude loads WAPT skills and validates provided credentials.
